text_block_list.text:
In the academy hallway, I saw El Condor 
Pasa and Mejiro Dober talking.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it is finally next week, yes! 
Shaking hands! Singing! Dancing! A fan 
meetup event to hype everyone up to the 
max!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're full of energy, El... I'm 
already so nervous, my hands are shaking a 
little.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No problem! That must be the pre-battle 
jitters, yes! Let's hype things up 
together on the big day!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I plan to send my mask to the 
cleaners and get an ultra luxury finish! I 
am already looking forward to that day, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*, *exhale*... The real thing is 
finally here. El, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Things might... not be alright, yeees...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What's wrong!? And where's your mask!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Th-The thing is... it was supposed to come 
back from dry cleaning this morning, but 
due to a mistake, it's delayed—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However... we cannot keep everyone 
waiting. I-I just... have to do it, yes.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, let's welcome them to the 
stage! El Condor Pasa-san and Mejiro 
Dober-san!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, n-nice to... meet you... yeees...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
T-Today... having so many people gather 
here... um... it is a great honor...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? She's not wearing her usual 
mask... and her vibe is totally different?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—U-Um! Thank you all so much for coming to 
our event today, a-ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I was really looking forward to today 
too, um... I couldn't even sleep last 
night... No, not like I didn't sleep at 
all, but...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Dober-senpai...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(...Dober-senpai isn't good with these 
things, but she's doing her best...! Yet 
here I am...!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(...I don't have my mask. I don't have it, 
but...! Right now, with all the courage I 
can muster...!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—E-El too! I was looking forward to today 
so much that I couldn't get a sound sleep!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But that is because I was excited, yes! As 
much as we can, to the utmost, full power 
at maximum throttle! Everyone, let's have 
fun together!

text_block_list.name: Dry Cleaner
text_block_list.text:
Hey, sorry about that, El-chan! Your dry 
cleaning is finished!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que!? Is that true!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for waiting, everyone! Fans! 
Dober-senpai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Revived!! In perfect form!! In peak 
condition!! The True El Condor Pasa has 
AR-RIVED, YEEEEEEES!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank you very much, Dober-senpai! 
For a moment there, I wondered what would 
happen...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, El is totally helpless 
without her mask. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...That's not true. Because even without 
your mask, you squeezed out all your 
courage, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I do think the mask is important, but... 
even so, you've had it inside you all 
along, El. A courage second to none.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps El's heart itself is coming to 
wear a mask of courage, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Strongest running, strongest heart, El 
super-strongest! Whoaaa! I'm suddenly 
feeling super happy, yeeeeeees!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...However, that courage came out only 
because Dober-senpai did her best trying 
to help me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We truly are the strongest tag team! Just 
like we declared during our pro-wrestling 
experience!
